Subject: Vendor sign-up, PO requirements, and payment timing

Hi Elise,

Quick intro — I'm Sergio on the Commercial Ops team at Redwood Inference. We're onboarding Greenpark as a customer (GP-4521) and need to get our supplier record created in your AP system so we can invoice against future POs. Can you confirm the exact vendor registration steps and the AP fields you require on invoices? A few specific asks: 

- Does Greenpark require bank-account verification (cancelled check or bank letter) or is a PDF remittance authorization sufficient?
- What invoice fields must match the PO exactly (PO#, PO line, GL code, etc.)?
- How do you prefer to handle VAT for EU flows — do you require supplier VAT + reverse-charge attestation on the invoice?
- Any notes on early-pay/discount fields (we sometimes apply 2/10 net30) and how to flag them on invoice submission?

We can upload documents via the vendor portal or send them over to finance. Sending Marissa and Laura here to coordinate.

Thanks — I'll pull together the docs once I have the portal link and file list.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

Hi Sergio — welcome, happy to help. Couple of quick items and links below. Please use the supplier portal to start (link included) so our onboarding team has one canonical record.

Portal: https://portal.greenpark.com/vendor-signup/GP-4521

Required documents/fields:
- Completed Vendor Registration Form (attached) — legal name, remit-to address, primary contact, bank account (IBAN or account+sort).
- Bank verification: bank letter or official bank statement showing account name and IBAN. We do not accept screenshots of online banking.
- VAT: for EU entities provide VAT registration number; indicate if reverse-charge applies (checkbox on the form).
- Invoice requirements: InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, PORef (exact PO#), LineDescription, LineAmount, SupplierVAT (if applicable), RemitAccount. PO number must be visible on each invoice line.
- Early-pay: we do support early-pay programs; flag any early-pay/discount terms in the "Notes" field of the registration and include the discount terms on the invoice.

AP contact: finance@greenpark.com (use for receipt/queries). I've attached the "Greenpark_Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf" and a PO template for your reference. Once registered, you'll receive a system-generated vendor ID and a DocuSign for standard supplier terms.

Best,
Elise Martin
Procurement Operations Manager
Greenpark Logistics

Attachments: Greenpark_Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf, Greenpark_PO_Template.xlsx

Hi Sergio — I'm Kara from Greenpark AP. Quick answers inline: 

- Billing/legal name: We prefer the invoice to match the vendor record. If you expect to invoice Greenpark from both the US and EU entities, please create separate supplier records (we do not mix remit-to accounts under a single vendor record).

- Remit-to selection: Separate vendor records required for separate remit-to (this allows PO routing to correct pay queue).

- Payment runs: Our standard runs are net30 with a payment cycle twice monthly (10th and 25th). New suppliers are on a 45-day onboarding hold for the first payment after vendor activation; you should expect the first payment ~45 days after registration completion and PO acceptance. Once vendor status is Active for one quarter we can consider moving to net30 hosts.

- VAT handling (EU): For cross-border B2B transactions where reverse-charge applies, include the buyer VAT in the invoice header and tick the reverse-charge box in the portal. We require SupplierVAT and BuyerVAT fields to be present in the e-invoice XML.

- E-invoice spec: When pushing invoices to our e-invoice endpoint include the following header tags exactly: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PORef, SupplierVAT, BuyerVAT, RemitAccount, NetAmount, VATAmount, TotalAmount.

I've uploaded our eInvoice spec and a PO example to the portal and initiated the DocuSign supplier terms for Redwood EU Ltd. Expect a DocuSign link shortly.

Best,
Kara Thompson
Senior AP Analyst
Greenpark Logistics

Attachments: Greenpark_eInvoice_Specs.xlsx
Related: DocuSign (https://app.docusign.com/sign/abc123)
